Name: Dumpster Diving by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]🗑️ Dumpster Diving
A Full 20-Level Garbage Can Skill for Stardew Valley
By Hemptress
Turn Pelican Town’s trash cans into an actual progression system.
[b]Dumpster Diving[/b] adds a complete custom skill centered around scavenging, treasure hunting, useful resources, rare finds, and increasingly powerful rewards.
Every fresh garbage can gives you something worthwhile.
No empty cans.
No useless junk.
No soggy newspaper betrayal.
Just pure raccoon ambition. 🦝
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]✨ FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Full [b]20-level Dumpster Diving skill[/b]
• Guaranteed useful reward from every fresh trash can
• No Trash, Soggy Newspaper, Broken Glasses, Broken CDs, Driftwood, or other junk-tier filler
• Custom XP progression
• Native-style XP notifications
• Clean custom skill progress HUD
• F7 Dumpster Diving stats screen
• Branching professions
• Level 15 and Level 20 mastery upgrades
• Location-themed loot
• Rare and ultra-rare treasure
• Jackpot system
• Lucky Streak system
• Rare-drop pity protection
• Ultra-rare pity protection
• Daily Hot Can system
• Multiplayer progression support
• Deterministic anti-reroll loot
• Save-friendly skill identity
• Compatibility-minded garbage can handling
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🗑️ GUARANTEED REWARDS
Every fresh garbage can searched through Dumpster Diving gives a reward.
The mod completely removes the feeling of checking a can and getting absolutely nothing.
It also filters out low-value garbage items.
You will not receive:
• Trash
• Soggy Newspaper
• Broken Glasses
• Broken CD
• Driftwood
Even at level 0, Dumpster Diving gives useful starter loot.
Early rewards can include:
• Crops
• Forage
• Food
• Wood
• Stone
• Coal
• Copper Ore
• Other practical early-game supplies
The skill is meant to feel rewarding from the very first trash can.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]📈 FULL 20-LEVEL PROGRESSION
Dumpster Diving uses a full custom skill progression system powered by SpaceCore.
Searching fresh garbage cans grants Dumpster Diving XP.
As you level up, the loot system improves through:
• Better item pools
• Larger stacks
• Higher-value resources
• Better item quality
• Improved rare chances
• Stronger profession bonuses
• Access to late-game treasure
• Better jackpot potential
The goal is simple:
Every level should feel more rewarding than the last.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🌳 PROFESSION SYSTEM
At Level 5, you choose your main Dumpster Diving playstyle.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🔎 Treasure Nose[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Focuses on rare loot, valuable finds, treasure, and stronger protection against bad RNG.
Best for players who want:
• Minerals
• Artifacts
• Treasure
• Rare items
• High-value loot
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🧺 Resource Goblin[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Focuses on quantity, practical supplies, useful bundles, and larger stacks.
Best for players who want:
• Crafting materials
• Food
• Farming supplies
• Larger resource hauls
• Consistent everyday value
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]💎 LEVEL 10 TREASURE PATH
Treasure Nose branches into two specialist professions.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🏺 Relic Hunter[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Focuses on collector-style loot.
Expect better access to:
• Minerals
• Geodes
• Artifacts
• Artifact Troves
• Museum-friendly finds
• Rare collector rewards
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🍀 Fortune Finder[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Focuses on raw value and jackpot-style treasure.
Expect improved access to:
• Diamonds
• Iridium
• Treasure Chests
• Prismatic rewards
• High-value late-game loot
• Better jackpot potential
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]📦 LEVEL 10 RESOURCE PATH
Resource Goblin branches into two different scavenging styles.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🍕 Pantry Pirate[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Turns trash cans into surprisingly effective food sources.
Focuses on:
• Cooked meals
• Larger food bundles
• Better food rewards
• Bonus food finds
• Powerful scavenged-meal bonuses
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🧰 Supply Savant[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Turns garbage cans into miniature supply depots.
Focuses on:
• Wood
• Stone
• Ore
• Coal
• Bars
• Batteries
• Cloth
• Fertilizer
• Bait
• Seeds
• Crafting materials
Certain finds can also provide complementary resource bundles.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🌟 LEVEL 15 MASTERY
At Level 15, your chosen profession automatically becomes stronger.
No extra menu.
No generic filler choice.
Your existing build simply evolves.
Treasure-focused players become better treasure hunters.
Resource-focused players become better scavengers.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]👑 LEVEL 20 DUMPSTER ROYALTY
Level 20 unlocks the final mastery tier.
This is where Dumpster Diving reaches its late-game potential.
Possible high-end rewards can include:
• Prismatic Shards
• Treasure Chests
• Golden Mystery Boxes
• Iridium
• Golden Pumpkins
• Pearls
• Magic Rock Candy
• Diamonds
• Other premium late-game items
These remain rare enough to feel exciting.
Dumpster Diving is powerful.
It is not a portable item spawner disguised as municipal sanitation.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎰 JACKPOT SYSTEM
High-level players can trigger jackpot rewards.
Jackpots are designed as true bonus moments rather than simply replacing your normal loot.
That means a jackpot should feel like:
[b]“OH. THAT’S GOOD.”[/b]
Not:
[b]“Cool, I guess this is technically different.”[/b]
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🍀 LUCKY STREAK SYSTEM
Dumpster Diving tracks unlucky searches.
If you go too long without a rare reward, your hidden Lucky Streak improves your odds.
The longer the dry streak continues, the better your chances become.
Once you land a worthwhile rare reward, the streak resets.
Bad luck is allowed.
Permanent bad luck is not.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]💠 ULTRA-RARE PITY SYSTEM
Ultra-rare rewards use their own protection system.
This keeps top-tier rewards genuinely special while preventing absurdly unlucky players from being locked out forever.
You still need luck.
The system just quietly stops RNG from becoming a supervillain.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🔥 DAILY HOT CAN
Each day, one garbage can can become the special [b]Hot Can[/b].
Hot Cans have improved reward potential and can provide better-than-normal loot.
This creates a small daily treasure hunt and gives players a reason to check more than one familiar garbage can.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🗺️ LOCATION-THEMED LOOT
Different areas favor different types of rewards.
Examples include:
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🍺 Saloon Area[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Food and prepared meals.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]⛏️ Blacksmith Area[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ore, minerals, geodes, and mining supplies.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🌱 General Store Area[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Seeds, crops, produce, and farming-related items.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🎣 Coastal Areas[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bait, fishing materials, seafood, and ocean-themed loot.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🔮 Magical Areas[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Essences, mushrooms, curiosities, and stranger finds.
[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🏝️ Ginger Island[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tropical resources and higher-level island rewards.
This helps each garbage can feel a little different instead of pulling from one giant generic loot pool.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎮 CLEAN NATIVE-STYLE UI
Dumpster Diving includes its own progression HUD designed to blend naturally with Stardew Valley.
When you search a garbage can, you can see:
• Native-style XP notifications
• Item pickup notifications
• A compact Dumpster Diving XP progress panel
• Current skill level
• Current XP progress
The UI is deliberately kept tidy and unobtrusive.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]📊 F7 DUMPSTER DIVING DASHBOARD
Press [b]F7[/b] to view your Dumpster Diving statistics.
The dashboard tracks information such as:
• Current Dumpster Diving level
• Current XP
• XP required for the next level
• Current loot tier
• Next unlock
• Profession path
• Total trash cans searched
• Rare finds
• Ultra-rare finds
• Jackpots
• Lucky Streak progress
• Rare pity progress
• Ultra-rare pity progress
• Best find
Because if you are going to become Pelican Town’s most accomplished dumpster archaeologist, there should be records.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎲 ANTI-REROLL SYSTEM
Dumpster Diving uses deterministic loot generation where appropriate.
Reloading the same day is not intended to let you endlessly reroll one garbage can until it produces a Prismatic Shard.
The treasure hunt should happen in Stardew Valley.
Not on the title screen.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]👥 MULTIPLAYER SUPPORT
Dumpster Diving progression is tracked per player.
Each farmer can:
• Earn their own XP
• Reach their own skill level
• Choose their own professions
• Build their own scavenging playstyle
One player can become a Fortune Finder while another becomes a Pantry Pirate.
Pelican Town can support multiple kinds of goblin.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]💾 SAVE-FRIENDLY
Dumpster Diving retains its existing skill identity for save compatibility.
Mod ID
[/color]
[code]Hemptress.StardewDumpsterDiving[/code][color=#D4D4D8]Author
[b]Hemptress[/b]
Players upgrading from earlier versions can keep their Dumpster Diving progression where possible.
[/color]
[line]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

🦝 THE RACCOON LIFESTYLE
There's something uniquely Stardew about inheriting your grandfather's farm, abandoning corporate life, moving to a beautiful countryside...
...and immediately digging through Mayor Lewis's garbage.
Dumpster Diving simply gives your descent into trash-based entrepreneurship the progression system it deserves.
